title: Vellure Hub
features:
🏷 FREE FEATURES
• Resources Farm
• Automatically farm multiple resources ( Meteors, Camellite Meteors, Cosmic Fragments, Sand Debris, Lab Crate, Devil Fruit)
• Items
• Automatically Store Items with Webhook
• Automatically Sell Items
• Automatically Delete Inventory Items
• Automatically Use Items
• Automatically Exchange Items for Reputation
• Moves
• Automatically Use Moves (Buso, Summon, Dopellganger, SDT, Hollow Nuke)
• Automatically Use Move Inputs (E, R, T, etc)
• Automatically Complete Quick Time Event (QTE)
• Npcs
• Automatically Farm Selected NPCs
• Select Bosses to farm them when available and your level allows you to fight them, prioritizing them over regular NPC farming
• Automatically Collect nearby Chests during Farm
• Quests
• Automatically Take Quests
• Miscellaneous
• Automatically Ascend Ability
• Automatically Use Tether Return
• Automatically Claim Playtime/Daily Rewards
• Automatically Convert Ability Shards into XP

💎 PREMIUM FEATURES
•  Auto Trait
• Select any Traits and Auto Roll until you find the desired one
• Automatically pick the selected next abilities when you pick Trait
• Set up Webhook for Trait Pick Notifications
•  Boundless Tower Kaitun
• Automatically does everything (Npc Farm, Stats, Ascension, Wave Skip, etc.)
• Set up Webhook for Boundless Tower Results Notification
• Configurable via config
•  Auto Instant Judgement Cut
• Automatically performs IJC with perfect timing; works with all Instant Judgement Cut moves
•  Auto Farm Camellite Golem
• Easily farms the Camelite Golem using Auto Perfect Block
•  Hitbox Extender
• Greatly increases the Attack Hitbox Offset during Npc Farm, allowing you to avoid taking damage
•  Skins
• Automatically (Recycle & Forge) Unusual Skins
• Set up Webhook for Unusual Skin Received Notification
